attainable_policy.ci_method: approximate Student-t interval over independent full-episode means
attainable_policy.confidence_scope: Monte Carlo uncertainty only; not a rigorous confidence bound on the optimum
attainable_policy.estimator: conditional expected arrival-state reward before each controlled edge
attainable_policy.factor_normalization: The two independent factors have separately selectable actions. Reward is the mean over selected arrival-state indicators, not joint success. Thus reward_both and reward_factor_1 have the same normalized optimal value.
attainable_policy.filter: exact action/token belief; no hidden-state or reward observations
attainable_policy.policy: stationary argmax barycentrically interpolated discounted grid Q; no artificial grid-state revelation
attainable_policy.random_stream: NumPy default_rng; reset then step-major draws of shape (n_episodes,)
attainable_policy.reset: uniform source prior -> neutral base edge -> visible token -> arrival posterior before first action
attainable_policy.status: Monte Carlo estimate of an attainable policy value, not the Bayes optimum or a rigorous lower confidence bound

convergence.interpretation: resolution stability is not a certified error bar or proof of equality to the continuous-belief optimum; minimum of computed upper bounds selected without extrapolation

details.estimator: mean conditional expected correctness before each pending token is revealed
details.filter: source <- normalize(source @ base_edge[revealed_token]); actions never alter the passive process
details.policy: argmax joint pending-token probability; independent-factor maximum probabilities are multiplied
details.random_stream: NumPy default_rng; step-major draws of shape (n_episodes, 2)
details.reset: uniform source prior; first decision has a blank observation and guesses the pending reset-edge token
details.status: Monte Carlo estimate of the exact Bayes-optimal prediction rule, not a certified maximum
